modalLead: Your Unraid server on the dashboard, web search in the search panel, real app icons for your self-hosted services, and a theme editor in the look studio — plus 81 fixes.

items.text: Seven Unraid widgets. An overview, the array, parity, shares, VMs, the UPS and Unraid's notifications, from the widget catalogue. Connect your server once under Config → Unraid.
Unraid alerts reach you. A stopped array, disk errors, a parity check with errors and Unraid's own alerts go through the same channels as your other alerts.

Search the web from the search panel. Type, then Shift+Enter: results from your own SearXNG or the Brave Search API appear under your bookmarks, with Web, News and Video tabs. Off until you pick an engine in Config → Behavior.
Containers and bookmarks get their app's own icon from two open icon sets, in the variant that suits your theme. Choose another with the pencil on an icon, or keep the letter.
A theme editor. Recolour a theme in the panel, or save what is on screen as a theme of your own, look included.
Sixteen more services for the Custom widget, services that sign in for a token, and figures that count entries in an answer.
Clearer charts in Health and Statistics: outages per monitor on a 30-day timeline, and every monitor per day.
Alerts through Apprise, and so to mail, Matrix, Signal and many more.
"Back online" arrives after a Re-check, and a URL on two pages counts once.
A bookmark as a QR code, to open it on your phone: Shift+J on a row, or QR code in the right-click menu.
:remove puts the bookmark in the trash, and its undo keeps what you changed in the meantime.
Config → Overview as panels: your install beside news, features and a tip.
A backup without tokens and passwords leaves out the alert secrets too, and restoring it keeps the ones in use.
